content: .mcpb (originally Anthropic's Desktop Extensions/.dxt, now under modelcontextprotocol/mcpb) is a zip archive of a manifest.json plus the server's own files (Node/Python/binary supported); built via the  CLI. No dedicated code-signing step documented for the bundle itself distinct from signing the underlying binaries/scripts it contains -- Claude Desktop trusts the manifest schema, not a bundle signature, so this repo's own binary/launchd .app signing+notarization stays the actual trust boundary regardless of whether a .mcpb wrapper ships too.
